name: Graduation Exam
description: Naruto fails the Academy exam, then Mizuki tricks him into stealing the Scroll of Seals. Iruka takes the blow meant for him.

name: Team 7 United
description: Kakashi's bell test: take a bell from the Copy Ninja before noon or go back to the Academy. Teamwork is the real test.

name: Land of Waves
description: Escorting the bridge builder Tazuna turns deadly: the Demon of the Hidden Mist, Zabuza, and his masked partner Haku lie in wait.

name: Exam Round 1
description: The Chunin Exams open. Get past the genjutsu guarding the exam room, meet Rock Lee, and survive Ibiki Morino's written test.

name: Exam Round 2
description: The Forest of Death: fight rival teams for the Heaven and Earth scrolls while Orochimaru hunts Sasuke.

name: Preliminaries!
description: Too many genin passed, so the preliminary one-on-one bouts begin: Kiba, Neji and a terrifying Gaara of the Sand.

name: Exam Round 3
description: A month of training with the Toad Sage, then the finals in the stadium: Neji's destiny and Sasuke against Gaara.

name: Destruction of the Hidden Leaf
description: Sand and Sound invade mid-exam. The Third Hokage faces Orochimaru inside the Sound Four's barrier while Shukaku rises.

name: The Akatsuki Assault
description: Two Akatsuki members walk into the Leaf: Kisame of the Mist and Itachi Uchiha, come to take the Nine-Tails.

name: Find Tsunade
description: Jiraiya and Naruto track down the Legendary Sucker. Orochimaru wants her to heal his arms, and three Sannin clash.

name: Get Sasuke Back
description: Sasuke leaves with the Sound Four. Shikamaru's squad gives chase, and one by one they stay behind to hold the line.

name: The Final Valley
description: Tayuya, Ukon/Sakon and Kimimaro fall one by one. At the Valley of the End, Naruto finally catches up with Sasuke.

name: The Third Great Ninja War
description: Years earlier: Kakashi, Obito and Rin's mission behind enemy lines at Kannabi Bridge, where a Sharingan is inherited.

C.title: The Third Great Ninja War Begins

B.title: The Third Great Ninja War Begins

A.title: The Third Great Ninja War Begins

name: Homecoming
description: Naruto returns after two and a half years with Jiraiya. Kakashi rings the bells for a rematch against Naruto and Sakura.

name: One Tail Under Attack
description: Deidara strikes the Hidden Sand from the sky and Gaara, now Kazekage, defends his village alone.

name: Hunt for the Kazekage
description: Team Kakashi and Team Guy race to the Akatsuki hideout, but Itachi and Kisame stand in the way.

name: Entrusted Feelings
description: Granny Chiyo and Sakura against Sasori and his Human Puppets, while Naruto and Kakashi chase Deidara.

name: The Foundation's Tangled Roots
description: Danzo's Root plants Sai in the new Team Kakashi. The Foundation tests them before the mission to Tenchi Bridge.

name: Battle at Tenchi Bridge
description: The meeting with Orochimaru's spy is a trap. Naruto loses control and the Fourth Tail breaks loose.

name: Distant Reunion
description: Inside Orochimaru's hideout Sai's true orders surface, and Team Kakashi finally finds Sasuke, colder than ever.

name: Special Training
description: Kakashi and Yamato train Naruto to add wind chakra nature to the Rasengan with a thousand shadow clones.

name: The New Two
description: The immortal Akatsuki pair captures the Two-Tails and comes for the Fire Temple. Asuma's squad intercepts them.

name: Shikamaru's Battle
description: Shikamaru avenges Asuma with Team 10, and Naruto debuts the Wind Style: Rasen Shuriken against Kakuzu.

name: Pain's Assault
description: The Six Paths of Pain level the Hidden Leaf with Almighty Push. Naruto returns from Mount Myoboku in Sage Mode.

name: Five Kage Summit
description: The five Kage meet in the Land of Iron under the samurai's watch, and Sasuke crashes the summit looking for Danzo.

name: The Fourth Great Ninja War
description: The Allied Shinobi Forces march against reanimated legends, the Gold and Silver Brothers and the masked man's army.

name: The Final Battle
description: The Infinite Tsukuyomi is cast and Kaguya Otsutsuki awakens. Naruto and Sasuke fight side by side, one last time.
